::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** March 17 [1895]  
**From:** Elderfield  
**Manuscript:** MS West Devon Area Record Office Ac 1092/33
:::

My dear [Charlotte](people/person_1587.qmd)
How shall I say how I grieve for you in this fresh sorrow so doubled as it is by all you have to care for, the poor little [Cordelia](people/person_1364.qmd)  I can only say.  May comfort come to you under this fresh shadow which God has thought fit to send to you and which must thus have infinite blessings within it[^1]

your loving
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: CMY refers to the death of Charlotte Yonge's daughter [Katharine (Yonge) Steer](people/person_1365.qmd).
